name: @pratibimba/m1-paramasiva-played-torus
description: M1-2/M1-5 played K2 torus Theia surface. Hosts the Bevy/wgpu renderer contract and consumes Ananda/Vimarsha state only through the shared profile bus.

scripts.test: pnpm build && node --test tests/played-torus-contract.test.mjs && cargo check --manifest-path wgpu/Cargo.toml && cargo test --manifest-path wgpu/Cargo.toml --test render_acceptance

rendererToolchain.bevy: declared in wgpu/Cargo.toml metadata for the native renderer host
rendererToolchain.wgpu: declared in wgpu/Cargo.toml metadata for the GPU backend
